title: Name a fixed label
summary: Elixir: Name a fixed label. Try :waiting.
introduction: An atom is a named label. It begins with a colon and is often used for a small set of choices.
learningObjectives: Name a fixed label with Elixir

blocks.text: Install Elixir. Save each example as lesson.exs and run elixir lesson.exs.
IO.inspect displays an atom with its colon, giving :ready.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not create unlimited new atoms from user input.
